svg.title: ArchiMind system architecture
svg.desc: Town and its Streamlit editor send a brief to a Starlette API and a durable job queue. Five concurrent Python worker roles interpret, retrieve, plan, check and style. Bedroom Chat and 3D Studio use separate preparation paths. Both paths use typed room models, seeded layout search and deterministic spatial validation. Results render in Plotly and Three.js. OpenAI is optional. Blender Lab MCP produces editable projects, previews and native-scale GLB assets for explicit use in the apps. Rhino archives are verified offline against released GLBs. The live licensed Rhino MCP session is pending. Based on source revision 524f3c9.
svg.metadata: Architecture source: https://github.com/ngstephen1/ArchiMind/blob/524f3c9b9ef7d8aa986fbd4b017bd34f1cc4b5d8/ . Brand glyphs: Simple Icons 15.5.0 and 11.15.0 (OpenAI), https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons ; MCP symbol from https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/blob/main/docs/logo/light.svg . Product and project names identify their respective technologies.
svg.text: How a design brief becomes checked geometry and an interior you can visit.
Solid arrows show the path from input to output.

a.title: Town browser and editor — open implementation
Town worker and specialists — open implementation
a.text: Starlette API → durable jobs → parallel Python tasks

a.title: Bedroom Chat and 3D Studio workflows — open implementation
Shared geometry and validation — open implementation
Town presentation — open implementation
a.text: Compare up to two alternatives. Apply one
to save it and enter the 3D walk-through.
That revision supplies the floor plan, bedroom
views, material board and furniture schedule.

a.title: Room results and renderers — open implementation
a.text: A/B selection drives the same design in
the 2D plan and the corresponding 3D view.

a.title: Optional OpenAI calls — open implementation
a.text: Interpret briefs for Town and Chat, or draft
Studio plans and recipes with user consent.

a.title: Catalog & scene evidence — open implementation
a.text: Five ABO products, two approved native meshes.
SSR room references come from gated local packs.

a.title: Town persistence — open implementation
a.text: SQLite locally, PostgreSQL in hosted mode.

svg.text: Operator workflow for the designer chair in PR #21

a.title: Blender Lab MCP — open implementation
a.text: The official MCP server drives Blender to model,
render and export the two chair variants.

a.title: Reviewed asset release — open implementation
a.text: Editable .blend, native-scale GLB and two previews.
Review dimensions and pin artifact hashes.

a.title: Town & Studio viewers — open implementation
a.text: Select a released chair. Load its verified GLB

a.title: Rhino 8 archives — open implementation
a.text: McNeel’s rhino3dm writes and reopens .3dm files
with editable part surfaces and a backrest curve.

a.title: CAD measurement check — open implementation
a.text: Compare width, depth, height and seat height
against each released GLB. Tolerance: 1 mm.

a.title: McNeel Rhino MCP — open implementation
a.text: Codex can connect to licensed desktop Rhino 8.
Live editing and viewport verification are pending.
